summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement on October 13, 2026 with one accredited investor under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The deal covers 2,458,334 ADSs (or pre-funded warrants) plus Series A-1 warrants for up to 3,687,501 ADSs at $1.20 per ADS, exercisable immediately over five years, at a combined price of $1.20 per ADS and accompanying warrant. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners served as exclusive placement agent, earning up to 7.0% cash fee plus $75,000 expense reimbursement and 122,917 agent warrants at $1.32. A registration rights agreement requires a resale registration statement within 15 days and effectiveness within 60-90 days. A 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker limits warrant exercise. Watch resale registration timing and any dilution-driven selling pressure.
